abilities.description: Pyroclast raises both fists and slams the ground, emitting a radial shockwave with a clear wind-up ring.
abilities.name: Caldera Slam

abilities.description: Molten vents erupt in a line across the arena floor, leaving lingering lava pools that deny space.
abilities.name: Fissure Eruption

abilities.description: A wide sweeping arc of molten slag that forces lateral repositioning.
abilities.name: Magma Sweep

abilities.description: Below 40% health the Warden's core cracks open, accelerating all attacks and igniting the arena rim.
abilities.name: Core Rupture (Phase 2)

acceptance_criteria: Arena scene loads with player spawn, boss anchor, and collision geometry.
All four boss abilities are telegraphed and executable via the combat loop.
Hazards apply damage-over-time and are visually distinct.
Atmosphere matches the molten palette with particles, fog, and emissive lighting.
Bot swarm test passes: player can damage boss, boss can damage player, phase two triggers.

audio.ambient: Low rumble, distant rockfalls, hissing steam
audio.combat: Percussive forge drums with rising tension on enrage

atmosphere.fog: Volumetric haze, warm and dense near the floor

lighting.fill: Orange omni lights from lava fissures
lighting.key: Low warm directional light angled through the caldera mouth
lighting.rim: Emissive glow from the Warden's core

atmosphere.sky: Ash-choked crimson sky with drifting ember particles

boss_archetype: Heavy bruiser with telegraphed area denial and a phase-two enrage
core_loop: Enter the caldera arena and read the environment for cover and hazard lanes.
Bait and dodge Pyroclast's telegraphed attacks (Slam, Eruption, Magma Sweep).
Punish recovery windows to build stagger; break the core to trigger phase two.
Survive the enrage and land the finishing blow before the arena floods with lava.

hazards.description: Persistent molten pools from Fissure Eruption that deal damage over time.
hazards.name: Lingering Lava Pools

hazards.description: In phase two the caldera rim ignites, shrinking the safe arena footprint.
hazards.name: Ignited Rim

hazards.description: Cracked basalt tiles that crumble after repeated impacts, opening new hazard gaps.
hazards.name: Unstable Ground

player_fantasy: A lone delver who reads telegraphed patterns, dodges molten hazards, and shatters the Warden's core.
zone_tagline: A collapsed volcanic forge where the mountain's heart still beats.
